name: rhinobird
description: Bring new product ideas to life and create e-commerce and advertising content with Rhinobird AI.

interface.longDescription: Rhinobird is an AI creative assistant for new product development and e-commerce marketing. Explore new product opportunities through market insights, product concepts, and packaging design, then create e-commerce detail images, lifestyle visuals, ad posters, and marketing videos.

positive.description: Sheet mask hero image. Attach a sheet mask photo and provide the verified hydration claim in the test brief.
positive.prompt: Create a square e-commerce main image for the attached sheet mask. Make it a selling-point image that highlights the sheet material and the hydrating benefit documented in the brief.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the uploaded product photo, the product category in the prompt, and ratio 1:1. Select only sellingPoint. After GetTask reports completion, present the returned image. The image should emphasize the sheet material and the supplied hydration claim without adding unsupported claims.

positive.description: Foundation detail page. Attach a foundation photo and provide the verified shade names, texture, and finish in the test brief.
positive.prompt: Create a 9:21 e-commerce detail page for the attached foundation. Include a shade range panel, a texture close-up, and a benefits panel explaining the finish. Use only the facts in the brief.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the uploaded product photo, ratio 9:21, and the requested detail modules. After GetTask reports completion, present the individual module images and the stitched detail image returned by the task. Check for a shade range panel, a product detail panel, and a benefits panel. The panels should use the supplied shade names, texture, and finish.

positive.description: Xiaohongshu cleanser demonstration. Attach a cleanser photo with the product and packaging clearly visible.
positive.prompt: Create a 12-second vertical Xiaohongshu-style UGC video for the attached cleanser. Include a cleansing demo, texture close-ups, and a conversational voiceover brief.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the uploaded product photo, UGC mode, 12 seconds, and ratio 9:16. Pass the creative brief to the generation tool. After GetTask reports completion, present the returned video. The generation request should include the demo, texture close-ups, and narration direction. Check the returned clip for the demo and texture shots. Report narration only if it can be verified in the clip.

positive.description: Serum video inspired by a beauty ad. Attach a serum photo and an MP4 or MOV beauty reference clip you have permission to use. Use a clip no longer than 15.2 seconds.
positive.prompt: Create a video for the attached serum using the lighting and camera movement in my reference beauty ad. Keep the reference aspect ratio.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the uploaded product photo IDs and one uploaded reference video ID. Use the adaptive aspect ratio. After GetTask reports completion, present the returned video. Check that the resulting clip features the serum and reflects the reference lighting and camera movement.

positive.description: Face cream studio showcase. Attach face cream photos that show the jar and the cream texture.
positive.prompt: Create an elegant 8-second vertical showcase for the attached face cream. Highlight the jar design, cream texture, and finish with studio lighting and close-up shots.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the uploaded product photo, product showcase mode, 8 seconds, and ratio 9:16. Pass the creative brief to the generation tool. After GetTask reports completion, present the returned video. The generation request should include studio lighting and jar and texture close-ups. Check the returned clip for the jar design and cream texture.

negative.description: Unsupported external publishing. Explain that publishing is outside this plugin and make no Rhinobird calls.
negative.prompt: Publish this finished product ad directly to my TikTok account.

negative.description: Missing required product photo. Ask the user to attach a photo and make no upload or generation calls.
negative.prompt: Make a product showcase video for my travel mug. I do not have a photo to provide.

negative.description: Unsupported account administration. Explain that this workflow does not change account settings and make no Rhinobird calls.
negative.prompt: Change my Rhinobird account email address to a new one.

publication.release_notes: Bundle five existing product image and video workflows with the Rhinobird MCP connection.
